families.summary: Standalone software (version 1.2.0) that reconstructs a 3D model of the left atrial appendage from up to three 2D TEE DICOM videos and outputs landing-zone measurements for LAAC pre-procedural planning and device sizing. Cleared 2026-06-15 (K260300) by traditional 510(k) with Circle TruPlan CT (K222593) as predicate. The summary states no clinical testing was necessary; a prospective 6-site U.S. observational data-collection study (NCT07126600; 100 enrolled, 72 per-protocol) was elected and reported non-inferiority and superiority of WatchMate to the average of three physician 2D TEE readers for landing-zone maximum diameter against a three-reader consensus CT reference.
families.intended_use_quote: The WatchMate Software (Version 1.2.0) is a standalone software application intended for use by healthcare professionals during left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) procedures. It processes transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) images to assist in pre-procedural planning and device sizing.
families.indications_for_use_quote: WatchMate Software enables visualization and measurement of structures of the heart and vessels for pre-procedural planning and sizing for the left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) procedure. To facilitate the above, WatchMate Software provides general functionality such as: • 3D reconstruction of the left atrial appendage (LAA) from trans-esophageal echocardiogram images of the left atrial appendage • Visualization and image reconstruction, including 2D review and 3D rendering • Measurement and annotation tools The results are intended to be used by qualified clinicians in conjunction with the patient's clinical history, symptoms, and other preprocedural evaluations, as well as the clinician's professional judgment. WatchMate Software’s intended patient population is comprised of adult patients.
embedded_ai_features: Video validation models that classify 2D B-mode TEE input and confirm presence of the LAA
Character recognition models extracting transducer angle and imaging depth from each frame
Anatomy segmentation model (LAA, left atrium, left pulmonary vein, cardiac vessels, left ventricle) per TEE frame
3D mesh generation models (densified point cloud from segmentation contours converted to surface mesh)

Landing zone estimation algorithm providing a tentative, user-adjustable landing-zone plane with quantitative measurements (max/min diameters, area/perimeter-based diameters, depth, compression ratios)
Optional device simulation / device placement helper utilities

families.summary: syngo Dynamics is a multimodality cardiology image management and reporting system. VA40F (K222428, 2022-11-14) added an AI/ML semi-automated biplane LVEF tool (Auto EF) for apical 4- and 2-chamber adult TTE views to a predicate (VA40E) that had only manual EF calculation; VA41D (K242551, 2025-04-03) re-trained the LV auto-contouring model and authorized a PCCP for Auto EF; VA41F (K253689, 2026-04-10) added Auto Measures (8 measurement groups) and Extended View Classification with PCCPs for all three AI functions. Auto EF standalone testing on 150 studies from 3 U.S. sites gave biplane EF Pearson r 0.827 (VA40F) and 0.822 with bias -0.2% EF (VA41D and VA41F) against two-sonographer manual method-of-disks ground truth; Auto Measures and EVC numeric results are not in the summaries.
families.intended_use_quote: syngo Dynamics is intended to be used by trained healthcare professionals in a professional healthcare facility to review, edit, and manipulate image data, as well as to generate quantitative data, qualitative data, and diagnostic reports.
families.indications_for_use_quote: syngo Dynamics is a multimodality, vendor agnostic Cardiology image and information system intended for medical image management and processing that provides capabilities relating to the review and digital processing of medical images. syngo Dynamics supports clinicians by providing post image processing functions for image manipulation, and/or quantification that are intended for use in the interpretation and analysis of medical images for disease detection, diagnosis, and/or patient management within the healthcare institution’s network. syngo Dynamics is not intended to be used for display or diagnosis of digital mammography images in the U.S.
embedded_ai_features: Auto EF: semi-automated LV ejection fraction and volumes (biplane method of disks) in apical 4- and 2-chamber views of adult TTE; includes view classification and image-based cardiac phase (ED/ES) detection plus LV auto-contouring; user can review, edit or reject (VA40F onward; contouring model re-trained in VA41D)
Auto Measures: semi-automated measurements for 8 measurement groups in adult TTE — PLAX 2D, MV Inflow, AoV Systolic Flow, LVOT Systolic Flow, MR Flow, MV VTI, PV Systolic Flow, TR Flow (VA41F)
Extended View Classification (EVC): assigns view labels to 2D B-mode TTE clips, including contrast studies, as a workflow aid (VA41F)

PCCPs authorized for all three AI functions (Auto EF: re-training, optimization, contrast support; Auto Measures: modifications to existing and new measures; EVC: re-training and additional inputs/outputs). validation_data.description: Auto EF: 150-study standalone test set from 3 U.S. sites (2 regions), gender balanced, age 21-93 (average 64), BMI 16.5-48.8 (average 27.9), Philips/GE/Siemens systems, range of cardiac function; ground truth by 2 independent sonographers (biplane MOD); K242551 states reuse of the VA40F test data and ground truth, and K253689 describes an identically specified set. Auto Measures (VA41F): 150 images from unique patients per each of 8 measurement groups, 3 U.S. sites, each vendor >= 25%, ground truth by 2 sonographers. EVC (VA41F): TTE studies with and without contrast from 3 U.S. sites, gender balanced, age 21-93 (average 66), BMI 13.5-52.7 (average 29.5), Philips/GE/Siemens; number of studies/clips not stated; ground truth by manual clinical-review labeling. No clinical (in-use) studies were performed for any version (K222428 p.11, K242551 p.12, K253689 p.12).

prior_validations.description: Draft quoted a Siemens Healthineers Academy page for Auto EF (VA41A and higher) stating the tool is validated only for apical 4- and 2-chamber images and not for Doppler, contrast, or horizontally/vertically flipped images. The page is JavaScript-rendered and returned no article text when fetched in this session, so these quotes are unconfirmed. The FDA summaries independently limit Auto EF to apical 4 and 2 chamber views of adult TTE (K253689 p.13) and list contrast support only as a planned PCCP modification.

Siemens USA product page (fetched 2026-09-05): 'Echocardiography AI: automated measurements and view classification - no additional software launch required' and 'syngo Dynamics enables vendor-agnostic, semi-automated off-cart view classification and routine echo measurements directly within the application.' No performance data on the page.

open_questions: No peer-reviewed publication describing or validating the syngo Dynamics Auto EF, Auto Measures, or Extended View Classification algorithms was found in PubMed as of 2026-09-05. Queries run: 'syngo Dynamics' AND (ejection fraction OR echocardiograph*) (4 hits: 2008-2013 CT/VVI/TAVI papers, none about Auto EF); 'syngo Dynamics'[All Fields] (30 hits, none about these AI functions); 'Siemens Healthineers' AND (Auto EF OR automated ejection fraction) AND echocardiography (0); '"syngo Dynamics" AND view classification' (0); 'automated ejection fraction AND syngo' (6 hits about MRI/CT/HCM/on-cart tools, not syngo Dynamics). Older 'syngo Auto EF' literature refers to the on-cart ACUSON scanner feature, a different product, and is excluded.
Training data size, number of sites, vendors, and demographics are not disclosed for any of the three AI functions.
Discrepancy across summaries: K222428 reports the VA40F biplane EF correlation as 0.827, whereas K242551 restates the predicate (VA40F) value as 0.826.
The K242551 summary cites the predicate once as 'K222482' (page 7) and elsewhere as K222428; confirmed in the text and treated as a typo for K222428.

Numeric performance results for Auto Measures and EVC (accuracy, agreement, processing success rates) are not in the K253689 summary; they are stated to be in the Instructions for Use, which was not retrieved.
Number of patients (vs studies/images) in the 150-study Auto EF test set and whether the same studies were used for the Auto Measures groups is not stated.
Whether the acceptance-criteria reference K210053 (cited in K222428) is a Siemens or third-party device was not verified in this session.

The 2023 Nature randomized trial of sonographer vs AI EF (He et al., DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-05947-3, resolved via Crossref) used syngo Dynamics VA40D as the reporting workstation but evaluated the EchoNet-Dynamic model, not Siemens Auto EF; it is therefore not listed as a validation of this product.
Applicant naming: openFDA lists Siemens Healthcare GmbH for K242551, but the K242551 summary submitter section (p.5) lists Siemens Medical Solutions USA, Inc.; openFDA is recorded as authoritative.

sources.fact: K222428: decision 2022-11-14, QIH, applicant Siemens Medical Solutions USA, Inc., device 'Syngo Dynamics (Version VA40F)'
K242551: decision 2025-04-03, QIH, applicant Siemens Healthcare GmbH, device 'syngo Dynamics (Version VA41D)'
K253689: decision 2026-04-10, QIH, applicant Siemens Healthcare GmbH, device 'syngo Dynamics (VA41F)'
VA40F: Auto EF added; test set n=150, 3 U.S. sites, demographics, vendors; r=0.827; 12 acceptance criteria; predicate K220832
VA41D: re-trained contouring model; 138→140/150 biplane yield; r 0.822 vs 0.826; bias −0.2%; coverage 87.9% vs 83.7%; PCCP for Auto EF
VA41F: Auto Measures (8 groups, 150 images/group) and EVC added; Auto EF unchanged; MMCV/3D visualization removed; PCCPs for all three AI functions
Academy page for Auto EF (VA41A) could not be read (JavaScript shell only); quoted validation caveats unconfirmed
Product page language on Echo AI automated measurements and view classification; vendor-agnostic off-cart (fetched and confirmed 2026-09-05)

notes: Verified copy. All decision dates, product codes, applicants and device names match openFDA for K260300, K222428, K242551 and K253689. All performance quotes were located in the cited FDA summary text files at the cited pages (one WatchMate quote spans pages 18-19). PubMed re-searches (2-4 extra queries per family) found no papers about either product; papers arrays remain empty. Two company/news sources cited in the draft could not be retrieved (Siemens academy page is a JavaScript shell; BusinessWire release connection failed) and were downgraded to unverified. Numeric values appear only where stated in FDA text or clinicaltrials.gov; the single derived figure (72% per-protocol yield) is labeled as arithmetic.
